fit_sampling: at most 20 evenly spaced observations in each 25-step phase per target; retain full raw trajectory
bank_selection: Smallest K with at least 2/3 initializations reaching 0.75 of the matched original teacher, held-out relative Frobenius <= 0.5 and mean physical clipping excess <= 0.05. Of passing seeds choose nearest the median success for that K, then lower seed.
final_access: single evaluation per frozen controller after model selection; seeds were used previously in v0.1
decoder: legacy 0.15*softplus(z); calibrated q95(train NNLS coefficients)*relu(z); compare zeros and a fixed N(0,1) probe, seed 701
projection: lambda=0; batched accelerated NNLS initializer then local clipped projected gradient; report convergence and latency
ppo_pilot_rule: fixed dev seed 73; checkpoint at 256,512,1000; extend to 2000 only if validation success at 1000 <50% or gains by >=10pp from 512. Freeze final budget after pilot.
